summary: The diff shows partial implementation of a civic reporting platform with authentication, complaint management, and educational features. However, many requirements are either missing entirely or only partially implemented. Key missing functionality includes video upload validation (30-90 second constraint), automatic location tagging, civic heatmap with geographic distribution, area-wise civic score calculation, volunteer/NGO marketplace, automatic 72-hour escalation system, RTI generator, before/after impact proof generator, tobacco spit-free section, and complete multi-language support. Some features like the helpline panel and leaderboards are present but lack full functionality.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement video upload functionality supporting 30-90 second videos with duration validation
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence of video duration validation (30-90 seconds) or video file size management in backend/main.mo. The Media type supports video, but no validation logic is present.

missing_requirements.requirement: Automatic location capture and timestamp tagging for image uploads
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence of automatic location capture mechanism in frontend code. FileComplaint page is mentioned in routing but implementation is not shown in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Automatic city municipal contact detection based on user location
missing_requirements.reason: HelplinePanel shows static helpline numbers but no logic for detecting user's city or displaying municipal contacts based on location.

missing_requirements.requirement: Real-time civic heatmap dashboard with geographic distribution and color-coded intensity
missing_requirements.reason: CivicHeatmap component is a placeholder showing only 'civicHeatmap' text with no actual map implementation, filtering, or heatmap visualization.

missing_requirements.requirement: Area-wise civic score calculation system based on report frequency and resolution rates
missing_requirements.reason: AreaCivicScores component shows hardcoded static data for three areas with no actual calculation logic based on real reports or resolution rates.

missing_requirements.requirement: City-level and school-level leaderboards with user scores
missing_requirements.reason: Leaderboard component exists but displays 'noData' placeholder for both city and school tabs with no actual leaderboard data or scoring logic.

missing_requirements.requirement: Volunteer and NGO task marketplace with task posting, browsing, and acceptance
missing_requirements.reason: VolunteerMarketplace page is routed but no implementation is shown in the diff. No backend types or functions for tasks, volunteers, or NGO accounts.

missing_requirements.requirement: Automatic 72-hour escalation system with reminders and reassignment to higher authorities
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence of time-based tracking, automatic reminders, or escalation logic in backend. No timer or scheduling mechanism visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: RTI draft auto-generator with proper legal format in Hindi and English
missing_requirements.reason: RTIGenerator page is routed but no implementation shown. No backend functions for generating RTI documents with legal formatting.

missing_requirements.requirement: Before/after impact proof generator with side-by-side image comparison
missing_requirements.reason: BeforeAfterComparison component is a placeholder showing 'noData'. No upload functionality for 'after' images or comparison logic.

missing_requirements.requirement: Motivational video section with age-appropriate content organized by category
missing_requirements.reason: MotivationalVideos component is a placeholder showing 'noData'. No video content, categorization, or video player implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Tobacco spit-free public report section with dedicated interface and awareness messaging
missing_requirements.reason: No dedicated tobacco spit section found. While IssueType includes tobaccoSpit, there's no specialized reporting interface or awareness content section.

missing_requirements.requirement: Complete multi-language support for Hindi and English including all UI text and generated documents
missing_requirements.reason: LanguageContext and translation keys exist, but many components show English-only placeholders. No evidence of Hindi translations for complaint documents, RTI drafts, or educational content.
